fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM98,380. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003074/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Language Requirement: Malaysian University English Test (MUET) Band 2 i. Pass STPM or equivalent with minimum Grade C (CGPA 2.0) in Mathematics and one relevant Science subject; OR ii. Recognised Diploma in Engineering / Engineering Technology or its equivalent with minimum CGPA of 2.0; OR iii. Recognised related Vocational and Technical/Skills Diploma with minimum CGPA of 2.0. International Students: TOEFL 500 or IELTS 5.0 or equivalent
